name: Ondo Finance
description: This share class provides liquid exposure to an ETF of short-term U.S. Treasuries

methodology.Fees: The daily yield earned by USDY and OUSG holders, calculated as each token's price increase over the day times the amount of tokens in circulation.
methodology.Revenue: Zero. Ondo passes all of this yield to token holders and currently charges no fee (USDY has no fee, OUSG's 0.15% fee is waived until 2027).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Zero, for the same reason as Revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All of the yield, since 100% goes to USDY and OUSG holders.
